title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 201 West Oklahoma Avenue in Guthrie, Oklahoma, as the "Oscar J. Upham Post Office".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 201 West Oklahoma Avenue in Guthrie, Oklahoma, as the "Oscar J. Upham Post Office".

summary.headline: A federal law renames the Postal Service building at 201 West Oklahoma Avenue in Guthrie, Oklahoma, as the Oscar J. Upham Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific Postal Service facility in Guthrie, Oklahoma a new official name, the Oscar J. Upham Post Office. It does not change how mail is delivered, what stamps cost, or what services the post office offers. The name honors Oscar J. Upham, as the bill's title indicates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 18, 2025, and the designation applies from that date.
